group_assessment.weighting: A large multi-cohort Parkinson's progression consortium; credible for survival statistics; no WWOX biology. The WWOX locus comes from the same group's 2021 genome-wide survival study. Not a per-author sweep.

field_density.note: LEGEND holds no record of the WWOX PD-progression SNP or of its discovery study (PMID 33958783).

resolved.how: Ref 49 (Liu CC 2018 review) has receipted readings in LEGEND (FTR-20261003-30158849-02); it is the paper's only mechanism citation for WWOX and is a review.

queued.why: Ref 17 (Liu 2021 genome-wide survival study, PMID 33958783) is the discovery source of rs8050111 and is absent from LEGEND; ref 48 (Kunkle 2019, PMID 30820047) is held only as a queue entry about another reading. Neither is read here; the locus-level conclusions of this reading do not depend on them. Landings are suggested in the candidate.
